title: Acer predicts PC prices will peak in mid-2027 due to memory and SSD cost pressure
summary: The manufacturer warns of 5-20% increases in Q4 2026 and a peak in 2027 before possible declines.

title: Microsoft patents a system that freezes gameplay to insert ads in exchange for ad-free game credits
summary: The patent describes pausing the game at key moments like boss fights or loading screens to show mobile free-to-play style ads.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation will occupy around 200 GB and arrive on April 8, 2027, setting a new size record
summary: The remake will require an additional download and could be the largest base game in history, according to analysis of its four editions.

title: Antitrust lawsuit accuses Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google of agreeing to slow AI development
summary: Plaintiffs allege the agreement to slow AI has been underway for months and call it 'self-serving' by big tech.

title: DLSS 5 shows poor performance on Intel and Apple Silicon graphics, with reports of failures on RTX 5080
summary: Nvidia's upscaling technology performs poorly outside its ecosystem and a user reports their card dying after using it in GTA V.

title: Optical drive supply collapse forces PS Audio and Naim to halt high-end CD player production
summary: Component costs have doubled, making high-end player manufacturing unviable.

title: CXMT begins mass production of memory chips and ASUS optimizes its AM5 boards for these Chinese modules
summary: The Chinese manufacturer enters mass production while ASUS releases BIOS updates to improve compatibility and latency.

title: Jensen Huang dismisses AI destroying the world by 2030 and rejects regulations: 'We must go as fast as possible'
summary: Nvidia's CEO rates catastrophe probability at 0% and dismisses Anthropic's warnings about existential risks.

title: Singapore pays micropayments to citizens to put down phones and read books in public libraries
summary: The National Library Board offers financial incentives to foster reading habits against screen addiction.

title: Samsung expects to more than double HBM4 and HBM4E memory production, increasing glass substrate demand 2.5 times
summary: The South Korean giant scales its high-bandwidth memory manufacturing to meet growing AI demand.

title: Alibaba launches open-source Qwen-Image-2.1 that outperforms closed models in image generation with only 7 billion parameters
summary: The open-weight model champions efficiency over larger proprietary solutions.

title: Vladimir Putin votes online with unlicensed Windows on an American Dell, despite Russian mandate for domestic technology
summary: The official Kremlin clip shows the 'Activate Windows' watermark and foreign hardware, contradicting import substitution policy.

title: Jev project launches family of decision models, a chatbot, and a social platform, all based on Qwen3.5
summary: The open-source initiative presents Kev, Jevtown, and an experimental chatbot, exploring new small model architectures.
